body:
Are you refering to the [priceRanges widget](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/priceRanges.html)? If I understand correctly you want to add button to the buttons to the UI so that users can do increments of the values?

Have you had a look at the [connector](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/connectors/connectPriceRanges.html)? Those are made for you to customize completly the UI of your widgets.
